## Fixed: TikTok downloads stuck at "Connecting..."

- **The real cause of the stuck TikTok downloads.** TikTok's video files are on tiktok.com addresses with no file type in them (`v16-webapp-prime.tiktok.com/video/...`), so NDM took the file yt-dlp had found for a video page of its own and asked yt-dlp to look it up again, and again, without end: the download stayed at "Connecting..." with 0%. A file yt-dlp found is now always downloaded as it is.
- **Stop works while yt-dlp looks a video up**, instead of waiting for it to finish.
